name: Marigold Kitchen
description: Family-run Goan restaurant on Fenwick Lane, Hackney. Coconut fish curry, pork vindaloo made the Margão way, and bebinca for afters.

facts.story: Marigold Kitchen cooks the food of Goa's south coast: coconut, kokum, vinegar and plenty of chilli. Recipes come from the family kitchen in Margão.
facts.transport: 5 minutes' walk from Hackney Central Overground.
facts.booking_policy: Bookings by phone. Walk-ins welcome at the bar. Groups of 8 or more please call ahead.
facts.dietary_note: V vegetarian · VG vegan · GF gluten-free. Tell us about allergies when you order; our kitchen handles nuts, gluten and shellfish.
